pages.text: Place the Matrix Source Reservoir Core at the midpoint of any bottom outer edge of a hollow 7×7×7 structure. Top and bottom are Arcane Structural Frames; the five middle walls are Tinted Glass. The unrestricted interior may contain a Matrix or any other blocks. Empty-hand use shows the projection.

The completed reservoir stores 100,000,000 Source and only accepts Source. An Integrated Source Relay draws up to 100,000 Source per second and exposes it to nearby Ars Nouveau devices. An incomplete structure cannot receive or output.

Use a Dominion Wand on two compatible Source nodes in either order; sneak-use a node with the wand to clear its links. A jar may link directly to a relay in the same dimension, or both may link to an Advanced Storage Lectern as a cross-dimensional gateway. The lectern's ordinary storage links remain available, and remote chunks must stay loaded.
